notes:
Summary:
- Product: low-latency scoring for payment auth + secondary fraud checks. Very sensitive to tail latency and unit cost.
- Customer quote: "We need p95 < 75ms for 20 token prompts in production, and cost per decision must be <$0.0006 equivalent."
- Interested in Redwood Dedicated (predictable throughput) and Optimize for batching/caching/quantization guidance. Also evaluating hybrid on-prem VMs for PCI scope.
- Main concerns: quantization-induced drift on fraud features, KV cache consistency for per-user session data, and deterministic fallbacks under overload.
- Asking for: perf baseline test (customer model + 4-bit / nf4-style quant), end-to-end latency numbers with continuous batching at target QPS, breakdown of token-cost vs request-cost, and a checklist for passing PCI review when using VPC + KMS.
- Stated timeline: internal POC (Mar 3-5), exec review (Mar 12), procurement (Apr).
